prompt:
A line-art multi-panel storyboard of one continuous scene of a live-action short drama: one image divided into a grid of 4 columns and 4 rows of equal 9:16 panels, 14 panels read from left to right and top to bottom; cells after the last panel stay plain white. Every panel is a clean, simple line drawing: uniform thin black outlines on a plain white background, with no shading, hatching, grey tones, colour or texture. Each panel has a thin black border, with plain white gutters between the panels. Location: Garden of the wedding venue, Day, bright warm sunlight from high on the right.
Image 1: the character sheet of Sebastian (30), look S2
Image 2: the character sheet of Guest 1 (25)
Image 3: the character sheet of Guest 2 (25)
Image 4: the character sheet of Lauren (50), look S1
Image 5: the character sheet of Natalie (25), look S1
Image 6: the character sheet of George (55), look S1
Image 7: the character sheet of Cassie (23), look S1
Image 8: the location Garden of the wedding venue, the front view, the establishing view, facing the back wall, with no people
Image 9: the location Garden of the wedding venue, the back view, turned 180 degrees, facing the front wall, with the left wall at its right edge, with no people
Image 10: the location Garden of the wedding venue, the left-side view, facing the left wall, with the back wall at its right edge, with no people
Image 11: the location Garden of the wedding venue, the right-side view, facing the right wall, with the back wall at its left edge, with no people
Image 12: the location Garden of the wedding venue, the floor plan seen from above: its top edge is the back wall, its bottom edge the front wall behind the front view's camera, and its left and right edges the left and right walls, with no people
Image 13: the blocking reference of this segment, the same place with its people in their places at the start; use it only for where each person is and which way they face, and keep each person on that seat or spot, on the same side of the room, in every panel until a shot moves them; do not copy its colours or light
Image 14: the prop glasses of champagne; use only structure, material, and color
Image 15: the prop bouquet; use only structure, material, and color
Draw each character so they can be told apart as in their reference image: the hairstyle, build and outfit in outline. Use the character sheets only for the characters, not for their layout, white background or multiple views. Use the location images only for the layout of the space and the place of its furniture and props, drawn in outline. There is only one of each vehicle, piece of furniture and prop that the location shows, defined by the location images, throughout all panels; when a panel shows only part of one, such as a car's hood, it is that same object, and no second one appears. Each panel shows only the characters it names, and nobody appears twice in one panel.
At the start: Sunny day in the wedding garden. There is one white wooden wedding arch with sheer white drapes and white flower garlands at the far end of the aisle runner. Two short rows of white folding chairs face the arch, one row on each side of the aisle. There is one small round white cocktail table in front of the boxwood hedge, holding one silver tray of champagne flutes. Natalie stands under the centre of the arch, facing down the aisle, holding the bouquet at her waist in both hands. George stands beside her under the arch on the rose-bush side, facing down the aisle. The boxwood-hedge side of the arch beside Natalie is empty. Lauren stands at the head of the aisle beside the front row of chairs on the boxwood-hedge side, turned toward the arch. Guest 1 and Guest 2 stand at the cocktail table, Guest 1 on the arch side of it and Guest 2 on the aisle side, each holding a champagne flute. Cassie stands at the head of the aisle a step in front of Natalie, on the rose-bush side, arms crossed, facing her. Sebastian has not arrived. The camera is on the aisle in front of the arch, on the rose-bush side of the aisle.
Panel 1: Close-up on the feet, ultra-low angle near the ground, locked-off camera. Sebastian's black patent oxfords step off the gravel path onto the start of the petal-strewn aisle runner.
Panel 2: Medium two-shot across the aisle toward the boxwood hedge, eye-level. At the cocktail table, Guest 1 and Guest 2 turn their heads toward the start of the aisle, and Guest 2 lowers her flute mid-sip.
Panel 3: Medium shot, track alongside Sebastian from the rose-bush side of the aisle, from the back row toward the middle of the aisle, slight low angle, waist up. Sebastian walks up the aisle between the white chairs toward the arch with an unhurried stride, straightening his shirt cuff, a calm half-smile on his face. He ends halfway up the aisle.
Panel 4: Medium close-up, clean single of Guest 1, tight on face and shoulders, eye-level. Guest 1's mouth falls open and her eyes follow Sebastian along the aisle.
Panel 5: Medium two-shot, follow Sebastian to the front row, eye-level. Sebastian reaches the front row of chairs on the boxwood-hedge side, where Lauren stands in his path, and gives her a polite, lazy nod.
Panel 6: Medium close-up, clean single of Lauren, low angle. Lauren steps back against the front-row chair, her eyes widening as she looks him up and down, one hand rising to her pearl necklace.
Panel 7: Medium shot, follow Sebastian from the front row to the boxwood-hedge post of the arch, eye-level, from the rose-bush side of the aisle. Sebastian steps past Lauren to the arch and takes his place beside Natalie on the boxwood-hedge side, turning to face her, while George stands on Natalie's other side under the arch, by the rose-bush post.
Panel 8: Medium close-up, clean single of Sebastian, tight on face and shoulders, eye-level. Sebastian gives a small, easy, apologetic smile, his steel-grey eyes on Natalie.
Panel 9: Close-up, clean single of Natalie, tight on face, eye-level. Natalie turns her head toward him and her lips part, her eyes widening.
Panel 10: Medium shot, over-the-shoulder shot past Natalie's veiled shoulder onto Sebastian, eye-level. Sebastian adjusts his bow tie and looks Natalie over with calm amusement.
Panel 11: Medium shot, over-the-shoulder shot past Natalie's veiled shoulder onto Sebastian, slow push in, eye-level. Sebastian gives a small confident nod and offers Natalie his hand, a faint knowing smile on his lips.
Panel 12: Medium close-up, clean single of Cassie, tight on face and shoulders, low angle. Cassie's crossed arms drop to her sides and her jaw falls open as she stares at Sebastian.
Panel 13: Close-up insert on the bouquet, eye-level. Natalie's hands loosen and the bouquet of white roses dips slightly at her waist.
Panel 14: Close-up, clean single of Natalie, slow push in on her face, eye-level. Natalie stares up at Sebastian, stunned, her lips parted and her blue-green eyes wide under the veil.
Keep the characters, the number and position of every vehicle, piece of furniture and prop, and the location's spatial orientation consistent across all panels.
No text, letters, numbers, captions, speech bubbles, panel labels or watermark anywhere in the image; no photographic rendering, shading or colour.
